ScheduleEntry.description:
One line of a schedule, stored as osTicket stores it: ``repeats`` says how the others read.

* never: the day ``starts_on``.   * daily / weekdays / weekends: every such day.
* weekly: ``day`` 1-7 (Monday-Sunday).
* monthly: the day of the month of ``starts_on`` (``week`` empty; ``day`` is then optional and must match), or ``week``
  1-5 / -1 (last) with ``day`` 1-7 (that weekday).
* yearly: the date of ``starts_on`` (``week`` empty; ``day`` and ``month`` optional and must match), or ``week``
  1-5 / -1 with ``day`` 1-7 in ``month`` 1-12.

post.description:
Exchange staff username + password for a JWT Bearer token.

- Uses ``application/x-www-form-urlencoded`` (OAuth2 password flow).
- Credentials are forwarded to the PHP bridge for validation against
  osTicket's native ``Staff`` model.
- The token carries identity only; what the agent may do is read from osTicket on every
  request (``GET /me`` shows what the API currently thinks you may do).
- **Rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP**, and an account/address pair that fails
  ``LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS`` times is locked out for ``LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS`` — ``429`` with
  ``Retry-After``.
- Refusals carry the reason in an ``X-Login-Error`` header: ``invalid_credentials`` (401),
  ``account_disabled`` (401), ``two_factor_required`` (403 — accounts with 2FA cannot use the
  API yet), ``password_change_required`` (403).

Returns:
    ``access_token``, ``token_type: "bearer"``, ``expires_in`` (seconds).
